# Clemson University Open Textbooks

> A Clemson Libraries-powered platform providing freely accessible, openly-licensed textbooks and educational resources built on Pressbooks.

Clemson University Open Textbooks is an institutional repository of open educational resources (OER) that enables faculty and students to discover, access, and publish peer-reviewed textbooks under Creative Commons licenses. The platform leverages Pressbooks technology to deliver content in multiple ebook formats including EPUB, MOBI, and Kindle.

## Key Topics

- Open Educational Resources (OER)
- Clemson University
- Clemson Libraries
- Pressbooks
- Creative Commons Licensing
- CC0 and CC BY-NC-ND
- Open Textbooks
- Course Materials
- EPUB/MOBI/Kindle Formats
- Subject Filtering
- Self-Publishing
- H5P Interactive Content
- Catalog Search

- [Clemson University Open Textbooks](https://opentextbooks.clemson.edu): Homepage for Clemson University's open textbooks platform powered by Pressbooks
- [About](https://opentextbooks.clemson.edu/about): About page describing Clemson Libraries' open textbooks initiative and publishing formats

## Browse & Discover

- [Catalog](https://opentextbooks.clemson.edu/catalog): Searchable catalog of open textbooks with Creative Commons licensing and subject filtering
